functions.purpose: Deserializes an in-game Activity (limited-time event) definition from a config/data node. Reads scalar fields ACTIVITY_ID, ACTIVITY_NAME(+0xD), ACTIVITY_NOTE(+0x2D), ACTIVITY_TYPE, ACTIVITY_TIME(+0x4D), ACTIVITY_RULE(+0x14D), ACTIVITY_ICON(+0x94D), ACTIVITY_BUBBLE(+0xA4D), ACTIVITY_BUBBLEINTERVAL(+0xACD), ACTIVITY_SERIAL(+0xAD1), ACTIVITY_URL(+0x54D); date range START_DATE/STOP_DATE/SHOW_DATE (validates STOP>=START); array ACTIVITY_PERIOD (Type='iParam1'), ACTIVITY_PHASES; ACTIVITY_PARAMS (iParam1..6 ints at +0x11B19,+0x11B1D,+0x11B21,+0x11B25,+0x11B29,+0x11B2D; szStr1 at +0x11B31 len 0x80, szStr2 at +0x11BB1 len 0x80); and a large ACTIVITY_DATA phase array. Each ACTIVITY_DATA entry (record size 0x423, stored at base+0xAD3 + n*0x423, count byte at +0xAD2, cap DAT_122e0088=0x40) has an InitState type byte selecting a variant parser and a condition dispatch switch(bCondType) cases 1..0x12. Case 0x30 ('0') parses an item-reward sub-block: dwItemID, nItemCount, bBindType, bOpenType, chColumn, dwFlags, bCondType, nGetCountMax, szDesc, plus a nested ItemRewards array (dwItemID,nItemCount,bBindType,chColumn; up to DAT_122e0090=10 entries).
formulas: ACTIVITY_PARAMS ints stored at record 0x11B19..0x11B2D (4 bytes each, iParam1..6)
ACTIVITY_DATA entry stride = 0x423 bytes; entries at (base+0x11393? no) base+0xAD3 + n*0x423; count byte at base+0xAD2
hunt-task sub-records stride 200 (0xC8), stored at auStack region, cap DAT_122e008c=3
phase/period record type tag == 0xC (data-node object type)
date sanity: reject if STOP_DATE < START_DATE
caps: DAT_122e0080=5 (period list), DAT_122e0088=0x40 (activity-data), DAT_122e0090=10 (item rewards), DAT_122e008c=3 (hunt tasks)
costs: item-reward sub-block carries dwItemID / nItemCount / bBindType (reward grants defined by the event config)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (config-node deserialization) — but populates the authoritative event/reward tables the server also loads; item-reward amounts here are the source data an authoritative reward grant must honor
functions.notes: Very large hand-written parser; condition switch cases map to activity trigger types. Item-reward offsets/limits (10 items, count byte) are the load-bearing economy detail.

functions.purpose: Deserializes a guide / beginner-goal definition (wide-char fields) that maps completion counts to reward ids. Reads: id(->+0x10), OpenCondition(->+0x14), Name; Instruction0..Instruction9 (each resolved to a level/entry id via FUN_100e1bf0/1c30 and appended to the vector at this+0x2C, 4 bytes each); and up to 9 (FinishCount_n, RewardId_n) pairs appended as 8-byte pairs {FinishCount, RewardId} to the vector at this+0x20 (grows by 8; stops early when a RewardId is 0).
formulas: Instruction list: vector at this+0x2C, element stride 4, capacity end at this+0x30
reward pairs: vector at this+0x20, element = {u32 FinishCount (local_440), u32 RewardId (local_43c)}, stride 8, end at this+0x24
loop pattern: parse FinishCountN then RewardIdN; if RewardId==0 stop; supports N=1..9
costs: each entry pairs a FinishCount threshold with a RewardId to grant on reaching it (up to 9 tiers)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (config-node deserialization); populates the guide-goal reward table that authoritative reward-granting reads (FinishCount->RewardId mapping)
functions.notes: Field order confirms pair storage is (FinishCount, RewardId). Instruction0..9 are level/entry references, not rewards.
